specification: For any owner, caller, generation, state, result type and engine closure. The engine is reachable only at the exact live generation; calling it elsewhere fails the closure's precondition. A refusal returns None and leaves the coordinator equal. The lifecycle never moves. An admitted call returns the engine's own result. Afterwards a present can be acknowledged exactly when this render succeeded into a host texture, so a failed render withdraws a frame still waiting. Every call is a step of the coordinator trace, so the earlier trace theorems hold with it.
behavior_change: render_gpu_to_host_view failing after the gate withdraws a pending frame and leaves the view dirty; the frame stayed acknowledgeable before
render_to_surface and render_to_surface_with_damage failing after the gate leave the view dirty, as render_to_backend and render_gpu did
every render failing after the gate withdraws a pending frame; a frame the host could still have presented is redrawn once
assumptions: The engine closure is arbitrary; its ensures relation is only what the contract states about it.
Traces are sequences of calls on one exclusively held value: Rust ownership, not proved here.
Verus default integer model, not a cross-platform execution test.

Verus+Z3.model_note: The count includes the re-verified dependencies. 8 wrong implementations fail a postcondition and 2 calls of the engine after a refusal or without the gate fail the closure precondition.

Proptest.includes: A decision table written apart from the production checks at the generation edges, recording how often the engine was asked; traces up to 48 steps against a separately kept record of the last render.

Miri.note: The five property tests are skipped under Miri. The module has no unsafe code.

cargo-fuzz.note: New in the chain. The engine's answer comes from the input. Generations stay far below exhaustion; that edge rests on the Verus contract and the table test. All targets ran 20 seconds on a shared VM.

Kani.note: No new harness ran in this chain.

Loom.reason: The type has no shared state, atomic or synchronization primitive and is held by exclusive reference; no concurrent execution exists to explore.

real_path_test.test: verification/host-surface tests; tests/native_host_renderer.rs (6 passed, 2 new); tests/native_gpu_host_view.rs (3 passed, 1 new, llvmpipe); tests/native_item5_journey.rs (3 passed)
real_path_test.mutation_checked: 21 wrong implementations were each applied to a scratch copy. 8 in the kernel and 1 in gated_render, and 11 removals of a HostRenderer entry's gate, failed at least one test. Removing the gate of focused_node survived.
real_path_test.surviving_mutant: focused_node without its lifecycle check: a foreign owner is refused by the view, and suspend and retire have already cleared focus, so by reading no reachable state tells them apart. Not proved equivalent.

not_covered: That each HostRenderer entry calls the right gate: tests and reading only; render_gpu and render_gpu_to_host_view gates were not mutated
